analyst.summary: AvenuesAI (the CCAvenue payment-gateway business) continues to grow revenue rapidly - up ~73% this quarter - and has genuine scale as one of India's largest payment platforms, with a growing UAE presence and new RBI authorization to issue prepaid payment instruments. However, this growth has come with a steep, multi-year decline in profit margins as competition in Indian payments has intensified, and returns on capital remain weak. The stock's moderate valuation appears to already reflect this trade-off between fast growth and thin profitability rather than looking mispriced in either direction.
